Q5735.reason: Federal claims on the face of the complaint make the case removable, and supplemental jurisdiction covers the state claims, so the court keeps the whole case; the judge's hostility is not a ground for remand.

Q5750.reason: Visual impairment making it hard to read screens is the most likely reason older people need careful consideration before relying on internet-based sources.

Q5130.reason: A waggling earlobe with each beat is the classic sign of an arterial pulsation, whereas hepatojugular reflux, posture variation and root-of-neck compression all point to venous pulsation.
